data.venue: The Cooper Associates County Ground, Taunton

data.question: Who scored the most runs for Kent in 2023?
data.cypher:
MATCH (b:BattingInnings)
WHERE b.team = 'Kent' AND b.season = 2023
WITH b.player AS player, sum(b.runs) AS totalRuns
RETURN player, totalRuns
ORDER BY totalRuns DESC
LIMIT 1
limits: A generated query can misread a question; the Cypher is shown so you can see what was counted.
